reference.label: A
reference.poseRole: Definition of reference frame at A, not an absolute physical pose measurement.

notes: A position declared by operator; immobility requested, not independently measured.
Instrument graduation alone is not total pose uncertainty.
Graduation 1 cm; total placement and angular uncertainties explicitly unknown. Do not substitute zero or a half-graduation bound for total uncertainty.
measurement.measurementSource: Operator reports 50 cm from A to B toward the LD06 zero-angle triangle, same orientation.
measurement.uncertaintyStatus: Not quantified: operator cannot bound centering/placement and orientation error.
